carry_trade_unwind_threshold.rationale: JPY/USD above 145 triggers carry trade unwind concern; TW market foreign outflow accelerates above this threshold

vix_threshold.rationale: VIX above 30 indicates global fear regime triggering TW foreign capital outflow

us10y_threshold.rationale: US 10Y above 4.5% signals rate-driven capital reallocation from EM equities; TW market shows sensitivity at this level

oil_shock_threshold_pct.rationale: 10% oil price surge triggers supply-chain cost shock for TW manufacturing; historical shocks: 2022 Ukraine (+30%), 2023 OPEC cut (+8%)

gold_surge_threshold_pct.rationale: 5% gold surge signals risk-off flight to safety, correlating with TW equity outflows
gold_surge_threshold_pct.todo: Validate against gold-USD-TWD correlation during 2022-2026 risk events

dxy_surge_threshold_pct.rationale: 1.5% DXY surge signals USD strength that pressures EM currencies including TWD; TW exporters face FX headwind

twd_stress_threshold_pct.rationale: 2% TWD depreciation in a session signals capital flight; TW central bank typically intervenes at this level

outflow_prob_base.rationale: 35% baseline foreign outflow probability under normal conditions; calibrated from TWSE foreign flow data 2020-2025

outflow_prob_max.rationale: 80% max outflow probability under extreme conditions; upper bound observed during 2020 COVID and 2022 rate shock

min_trend_strength.rationale: Minimum 0.7 trend strength for structural classification; below this threshold trends are considered noise
min_trend_strength.todo: Calibrate against TW structural trend detection accuracy 2020-2026

min_confidence.rationale: 75% minimum confidence for structural trend signal; balances false positive rate vs early detection

min_hit_rate.rationale: 70% minimum historical hit rate for narrative events to be considered valid structural trends
min_hit_rate.todo: Validate against narrative event hit rate distribution

override_threshold.rationale: 0.65 threshold for structural trend to override cyclical signals; must be lower than MinConfidence to prioritize structure

ai_revenue_growth_threshold.rationale: 50% YoY AI revenue growth threshold flags structural AI capex surge; TSMC AI revenue grew ~50% in 2024-2025

cowos_utilization_threshold.rationale: 85% CoWoS utilization signals near-capacity AI packaging demand; TSMC CoWoS utilization tracked at 90%+ in 2025

capex_growth_threshold.rationale: 40% YoY capex growth flags structural capacity expansion; TSMC capex grew ~34% in 2024, ~40% planned for 2025

semiconductor_index_threshold.rationale: Placeholder for semiconductor index trend threshold; pending index construction
semiconductor_index_threshold.todo: Define once TW semiconductor composite index is built

levels.rationale: Five-tier drawdown risk framework: none (0%), light (15%), moderate (35%), severe (60%), emergency (90%); calibrated to TW market correction patterns
levels.todo: Validate drawdown level thresholds against 2020-2026 TWSE drawdown distribution

orange_override_min_score.rationale: Minimum composite score for orange (moderate) drawdown override of agent recommendations

red_override_min_score.rationale: Minimum composite score for red (severe/emergency) drawdown override; must be > OrangeOverrideMinScore

sector_constraints_risk_off.rationale: Risk-off sector constraints: AI supply chain cut to 30% of normal, small cap/EM near-zero; gold/utilities boosted as defensive rotation

sector_constraints_carry_trade_unwind.rationale: Carry trade unwind constraints: equities severely curtailed (5-10%), cash doubled; based on 2024 JPY carry unwind impact on TW markets

sector_constraints_sector_rotation.rationale: Sector rotation constraints: energy/oil services boosted 1.5-1.8x on commodity surge; high-valuation tech and rate-sensitives cut to 30-40%

base_allocations.rationale: TW market sector allocation: semiconductor (19%) + AI supply chain (15%) dominate (34% combined); defensive+cash (20%) reserve; all sectors sum to 100%
base_allocations.todo: Calibrate sector weights against TWSE sector index market cap weights 2025-2026

min_allocation.rationale: Minimum 2% sector allocation prevents zero-weight exclusion of small sectors

max_allocation.rationale: Maximum 40% single-sector allocation prevents over-concentration; ~2x semiconductor base weight (19%) allows tactical overweight

rebalance_threshold.rationale: 1% rebalance threshold avoids excessive trading; sector weight deviation must exceed 1% to trigger rebalance

cooldown_period_hours.rationale: 24-hour cooldown between strategy switches prevents whipsaw during volatile regime transitions
cooldown_period_hours.todo: Test 24h vs 48h vs 72h cooldown impact on strategy stability

configs.rationale: Five strategy states from normal (full risk) to suspended (no positions); progressive de-risking: cautious → defensive → hedged → suspended
configs.todo: Validate strategy state transitions with backtest across 2022 (bear), 2023-2024 (bull), 2025 (mixed) cycles

vix_momentum_crash_threshold.rationale: VIX above 30 signals momentum crash regime; TW market foreign flow sensitivity increases ~3x above this level

crowding_penalty_agents_3.rationale: When 3 agents crowd same stock, conviction reduced to 75% to prevent herding; based on Kelly criterion adjustment for correlated bets

crowding_penalty_agents_4.rationale: When 4+ agents crowd same stock, conviction reduced to 60%; exponential penalty as crowding increases

min_trade_amount.rationale: 100K TWD minimum trade amount filters out uneconomically small orders; ~$3K USD at current FX

max_stocks_default.rationale: Default 8 stocks max per session balances diversification with position concentration; aligned with baseline MaxOpenPositions (5) + buffer

max_stocks_min.rationale: Minimum 5 stocks ensures basic sector diversification across semiconductor, AI, financials, shipping, and one defensive

max_stocks_max.rationale: Maximum 12 stocks prevents over-diversification diluting alpha; above 12, marginal diversification benefit < transaction cost

conviction_floor_default.rationale: Minimum 50 conviction (out of 100) for executor recommendations to be considered; below 50 is effectively a coin flip
conviction_floor_default.todo: Calibrate floor against executor historical precision-recall curve

neutral_regime_sizing_factor.rationale: 85% position sizing in neutral regime reduces max position from full weight to 85%; provides 15% buffer for regime uncertainty
neutral_regime_sizing_factor.todo: Calibrate sizing factor [0.70-1.00] via walk-forward backtest per regime
